answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1214 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the karst. The comet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the tundra queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Each copy needs 5 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
